description: This Java source file implements a connection factory for AMQP connections using the vertx-proton library. It manages connection parameters, SSL configurations, timeouts, and event handling for establishing and maintaining connections to an AMQP server.

classes.name: ConnectionFactoryImpl
classes.description: A final class that implements the ConnectionFactory interface, providing methods to create and manage AMQP connections via Vert.x and ProtonClient, including SSL configuration and connection timeout handling.

methods.name: ConnectionFactoryImpl
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the connection factory with a Vert.x instance and configuration properties, ensuring non-null parameters.

methods.name: setProtonClient
methods.description: Sets the ProtonClient instance used for creating connections, replacing default if provided.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name property from configuration, identifying the connection factory.

methods.name: getHost
methods.description: Returns the hostname from configuration for the AMQP server.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Returns the port number configured for the AMQP server.

methods.name: getPathSeparator
methods.description: Returns the path separator string used in connection URIs.

methods.name: connect (overloads)
methods.description: Initiates an asynchronous connection to the AMQP server with specified options and handlers, managing SSL, timeouts, and connection lifecycle events.

methods.name: failConnectionAttempt
methods.description: Handles connection failure by logging and invoking the failure handler.

methods.name: handleConnectionAttemptResult
methods.description: Processes the result of an attempt to connect, handling success, timed-out, or failed attempts, and setting connection handlers.

methods.name: handleTimedOutConnectionAttemptResult
methods.description: Deals with connection attempts that have timed out, closing or ignoring subsequent success/failure results accordingly.

methods.name: handleTimedOutOpenHandlerResult
methods.description: Logs and manages open frame responses received after a connection attempt has already timed out.

methods.name: addOptions
methods.description: Configures SASL, SSL, and other connection options based on provided credentials and configuration, including security protocols.

methods.name: addTlsTrustOptions
methods.description: Sets up SSL trust options and OpenSSL configurations for the client, considering hostname verification and SSL engine options.

methods.name: addTlsKeyCertOptions
methods.description: Attaches client key and certificate options to the connection if specified, enabling external SASL mechanisms.

methods.name: createClientOptions
methods.description: Generates default ProtonClientOptions with preset timeout, heartbeat, and reconnect settings.
